hints: Complete square on $x^2 + y^2 - 6x - 4y - 7 = 0$: $(x - 3)^2 + (y - 2)^2 = 20$, so centre is $(3, 2)$.
walkthrough:
Check the point lies on the circle before using its radius direction.
Complete the square to find centre $(3, 2)$:
$$(x - 3)^2 - 9 + (y - 2)^2 - 4 - 7 = 0 \implies (x - 3)^2 + (y - 2)^2 = 20$$

Find the tangent gradient and line equation:
$$m_{\text{rad}} = \dfrac{6 - 2}{5 - 3} = 2 \implies m_{\text{tan}} = -\dfrac{1}{2}$$
$$y - 6 = -\dfrac{1}{2}(x - 5) \implies x + 2y = 17$$
